#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
using ull = unsigned long long;
using pii = pair<int, int>;
using pll = pair<ll, ll>;
using ld = long double;
using plp = pair<ld, ld>;

const ll MOD = 1000000009;
const ll INF = MOD * MOD;

ll mod_pow(ll base, ll exp, ll m = MOD) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % m;
        base = (base * base) % m;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

struct ModInt {
    ll val;
    ModInt() : val(0) {}
    ModInt(ll v) : val(v % MOD) {
        if (val < 0) val += MOD;
    }
    operator ll() const { return val; }
};

ModInt operator+(const ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) {
    ModInt res;
    res.val = (a.val + b.val) % MOD;
    return res;
}

ModInt operator-(const ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) {
    ModInt res;
    res.val = (a.val - b.val + MOD) % MOD;
    return res;
}

ModInt operator*(const ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) {
    return ModInt((a.val * b.val) % MOD);
}

ModInt operator/(const ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) {
    return a * ModInt(mod_pow(b.val, MOD - 2, MOD));
}

bool operator==(const ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) {
    return a.val == b.val;
}

const int MAX_N = 1 << 18;
ModInt fact[MAX_N], factinv[MAX_N];

void init_factorials() {
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N - 1; ++i) {
        fact[i + 1] = fact[i] * (i + 1);
    }
    factinv[MAX_N - 1] = ModInt(1) / fact[MAX_N - 1];
    for (int i = MAX_N - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
        factinv[i] = factinv[i + 1] * (i + 1);
    }
}

ModInt comb(int n, int k) {
    if (k < 0 || k > n) return ModInt(0);
    return fact[n] * factinv[k] * factinv[n - k];
}

using mP = pair<ModInt, ModInt>;

mP mul(const mP& a, const mP& b) {
    return {a.first * b.first, a.second * b.first + a.first * b.second};
}

mP add(const mP& a, const mP& b) {
    return {a.first + b.first, a.second + b.second};
}

mP dp[501];

void precompute() {
    init_factorials();
    dp[0] = {ModInt(1), ModInt(0)};
    dp[1] = {ModInt(2), ModInt(0)};
    for (int n = 2; n <= 500; ++n) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            ModInt cnt = n + 1;
            ModInt sum = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                sum += abs(j - k);
            }
            mP cl = dp[j];
            mP cr = dp[n - 1 - j];
            mP x = mul(cl, cr);
            x.first *= comb(n - 1, j);
            x.second *= comb(n - 1, j);
            x = mul(x, {cnt, sum});
            dp[n] = add(dp[n], x);
        }
    }
}

mP dp2[502][501];

void solve() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cin >> MOD;
    precompute();
    dp2[0][0] = {ModInt(1), ModInt(0)};
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int k = 0; k <= i; ++k) {
            for (int j = i; j < n; ++j) {
                int ni = min(j + 2, n);
                int nk = k + j - i + 1;
                if (nk <= m) {
                    mP x = mul(dp2[i][k], dp[j - i + 1]);
                    x.first *= comb(ni, k);
                    x.second *= comb(ni, k);
                    dp2[ni][nk] = add(dp2[ni][nk], x);
                }
            }
            dp2[i + 1][k] = add(dp2[i + 1][k], dp2[i][k]);
        }
    }
    cout << dp2[n][m].second << "\n";
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
